title: A/R Collection: a customer ticked by link is named even if hard to find
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • More than 50 customers have overdue invoices on today's date; {Customer-A}'s name comes late in name order, so it is not among the first results of the Customer search.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-24 Late In The List.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Collection is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Customer filter, search for {Customer-A} and tick it.
  2. Copy the page address.
  3. Paste the address into a new tab.
  4. Read the Customer chip.
  5. Open the Customer menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the chip shows {Customer-A}'s name.
  • Step 2: the address is copied.
  • Step 3: the report opens with only {Customer-A}'s group.
  • Step 4: the chip names {Customer-A}.
  • Step 5: {Customer-A} is shown ticked in the menu.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R14: “A customer or vendor ticked through a link, a reload or a Summary drill-down is named and ticked on the chip, even when it is not among the first results of the chip's search.”
